  nominal 0x00: sample spacing != 50: [(7, 51)]
  jitter10% 0xff: sample spacing != 50: [(7, 51)]

  +2% 0x55: sample spacing != 50: [(7, 51)]

  -2% 0x40: sample spacing != 50: [(7, 51)]
  +2%+jit10% 0xc3: sample spacing != 50: [(7, 51)]

  -0.2% 0x00: sample spacing != 50: [(7, 51)]
assert not ['nominal 0xa5: sample spacing != 50: [(7, 51)]', 'nominal 0x5a: sample spacing != 50: [(7, 51)]', 'nominal 0x00: samp...!= 50: [(7, 51)]', 'jitter10% 0x80: sample spacing != 50: [(7, 51)]', '+2% 0x01: sample spacing != 50: [(7, 51)]', ...]
